text: I was brought to Vegas all the time. I saw a lot of shows before I turned 21. I have an idea of what these productions can be. Its fine, but not a must see in Vegas. I would not build a trip around it. The circular stage is really clever. From almost any seat, you get a decent view. That is rare in these big shows. If you stay at the Wynn or Encore, you can get tickets for 99. Normally they cost 125. I think the individual acts are really good. The performers are strong. Aerialists and acrobats, etc. But I have seen these things done as well in Cirque du Soleil shows. The story is unclear. It is not there. I do not really understand what it is trying to say. There is too much going on. Too many visuals, too many moving pieces, too many attempts to wow. I think less would be more. But with the few cool stunts aside, it was just a regular show. I was not blown away. The people I was with did not seem to be overwhelmed. Some of my friends did enjoy it, so if you have never seen it, go. Especially if you get the Wynn and Encore deal. But I would not see it again or pay full price a second time. It tries to be this stereotypical big flashy Vegas show where more is better. But to me, more was just messier.
